name: pptx-studio
description: Create, edit, analyse and export presentations with an HTML-editable workflow: read existing PPTX files, modify them while keeping their formatting, preview and edit decks in the browser, and export fully editable PPTX and PDF.

description_i18n.en: Presentation workflow for PPTX: read/analyse existing decks, edit them in place, generate new decks from themes or templates, preview and edit in the browser, export fully editable PPTX.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 演示文稿工作流：读取与分析已有 PPTX、保留原格式地修改、按主题或模板生成新 PPT、在浏览器里预览与编辑、导出完全可编辑的 PPTX 与 PDF。
